rows: Equipment: 46G negative-sequence overcurrent protection (Negative Phase Sequence), RARIB, ABB
Procedure: Test the protection using the PHU 100 current injection set

sections_en.text: This document sets out the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs.
The unit is out of service
Verify that the device to be tested is as stated on the Name Plate

sections_en.text: AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA

items: Safety helmet and safety shoes
PHU 100 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
Millisecond counter type MCS 5 N (Timer)
Test comb type RTXH 18, test leads used

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

items: Verify that the unit is out of service
Verify that the device to be tested is as stated on the Name Plate
Place the RTXH 18 test comb in test socket type RTXP18 at the relay a64G
Short points 1A and 2A on the test comb (to connect DC) — Shorted 1A, 2A
Short points 4A and 6A on the test comb — simulate negative phase sequence by shorting 4A, 6A
Inject current at points (3A, 5A) until the Alarm signal appears
Record the Alarm current reading
Continue injecting current at points (3A, 5A) until the Start signal appears
Record the Start current reading
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points (T1, T2) in the PHU100 current injection set
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (17A, 18A) in the RTXH 18 test comb
Inject current of value 4.55 × √3 = 7.88 A at points (3A, 5A) in the RTXH 18 test comb
Disconnect the injection set
Set the timer Start Mode to Contact and set the timer Stop Mode to DC V
Reset the timer
Connect the injection set
Record the Start time reading
Disconnect the injection set
Connect the timer Stop terminal to points (12A, 18A) in the RTXH 18 test comb
Inject current of value [1A > 0.63 at points (3A, 5A) in the RTXH 18 test comb
Disconnect the injection set
Set the timer Start Mode to Contact and set the timer Stop Mode to DCV
Reset the timer
Connect the injection set
Record the Alarm time reading
Remove Test plug type RTXH18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 at the relay (a48G)

Status: APPROVED

Next review date: January 2008
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs.
The unit is out of service
Verify that the device to be tested is as stated on the Name Plate

Safety helmet and safety shoes
PHU 100 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA

Disconnect the injection set
Set the timer Start Mode to Contact and set the timer Stop Mode to DC V
Reset the timer
Connect the injection set
Record the Start time reading
Disconnect the injection set
Connect the timer Stop terminal to points (12A, 18A) in the RTXH 18 test comb
Inject current of value [1A > 0.63 at points (3A, 5A) in the RTXH 18 test comb

Set the timer Start Mode to Contact and set the timer Stop Mode to DCV
